mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION R JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS LB ON R.lbidx = LB.lbidx JOIN BOOKS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN USER U ON R.uidx = U.uidx WHERE R.delyn IN ('N', 'Y')

SELECT R.ridx, R.lbidx, B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, LB.callName, U.name, U.userNumber, R.pickupDate, R.status FROM RESERVATION R JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS LB ON R.lbidx = LB.lbidx JOIN BOOKS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx JOIN USER U ON R.uidx = U.uidx WHERE R.delyn IN ('N', 'Y')
ORDER BY R.ridx DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N'

SELECT B.coverImg, B.title, B.author, B.publisher, LB.lbidx, LB.code, LB.callName, LB.location, LB.dueDate, LB.status FROM LIBRARYBOOKS AS LB JOIN BOOKS AS B ON LB.bidx = B.bidx WHERE B.delyn = 'N' AND LB.delyn = 'N'
ORDER BY LB.lbidx DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
SELECT pickupDate FROM RESERVATION WHERE lbidx = #{lbidx} AND delyn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE RESERVATION SET status = '예약취소', delyn = 'Y' WHERE ridx = #{ridx}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOAN WHERE lbidx = #{lbidx} AND returnDate IS NULL
SELECT loanDate, dueDate, returnDate FROM LOAN WHERE lbidx = #{lbidx} AND delyn = 'N'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.startDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(o.endDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate FROM OVERDUE o JOIN `USER` u ON o.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND o.status = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION (lbidx, uidx, regDate, pickupDate, dueDate, status) VALUES ( #{lbidx}, (SELECT uidx FROM `USER` WHERE userNumber = #{userNumber}), #{regDate}, #{pickupDate}, #{dueDate}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE LIBRARYBOOKS SET status = '예약대기' WHERE status = '대출가능' AND lbidx IN ( SELECT lbidx FROM RESERVATION WHERE delyn = 'N' AND DATEDIFF(pickupDate, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 )
UPDATE RESERVATION SET pickupDate = #{pickupDate}, dueDate = #{dueDate}, `modify` = NOW() WHERE ridx = #{ridx}
mapper.select: SELECT innerTable.*, @rownum := @rownum + 1 AS rownum FROM ( SELECT r.ridx, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, DATE_FORMAT(r.regDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS regDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.pickupDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS pickupDate, DATE_FORMAT(r.dueDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS dueDate, r.status FROM RESERVATION r JOIN USER u ON r.uidx = u.uidx JOIN LIBRARYBOOKS lb ON r.lbidx = lb.lbidx JOIN BOOKS b ON lb.bidx = b.bidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber} ORDER BY r.ridx DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum} ) AS innerTable CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rownum := #{startPageNum} + 1) AS r
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION R JOIN USER u ON R.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.userNumber = #{userNumber}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION r JOIN `USER` u ON r.uidx = u.uidx WHERE r.lbidx = #{lbidx} AND u.userNumber = #{userNumber} AND r.status IN ('예약중','수령완료') AND r.delyn = 'N'
